content_zh:
第一章 关键时刻掉链子
（喜欢本书的小伙伴，可以去看看作者君的新书【宠物
召唤师峡谷中，一场团战一触即发，这是一场战队的斗争，两方均势。
此时紫色方作为防守方，在中路仅剩一座的外塔塔下清兵，而蓝色方则把兵线压在塔下，在塔外进行骚扰Poke（远程消耗）。
虽然蓝色方积极的把兵线压住，但是由于紫色方有着爆破鬼才吉格斯这一清兵能力极强的英雄，所以基本兵线一来，不到两秒的时间就被清完了。
顺便还时不时丢一发弹跳炸弹和海克斯爆破雷区来进行骚扰牵制，让人极其恶心。
YY语音频道中。
“草，这样要怎么打，本来想强杀，搞得现在没兵线都不敢上了。”
“而且对面的慎已经快把我们的上路外塔全拆了。真是把四分一推给发挥到极致了。”
一道浑厚的声音从语音中发出，声音充满郁闷无语，却是队友德玛西亚皇子发出的。
而队友们听到他的抱怨也是一阵埋怨，怎么就没想到把炸弹人给BAN了呢，现在真是打得有点迷茫了。
听着队友们的抱怨，苏环心中没有一丝波澜，眼中冷静，紧紧的盯着电脑屏幕，这一次的战斗是他晋级王者的最后一把，赢了就晋级王者，输了就又是退回钻石一。
想要再次打晋级赛也不知道要何年何月。
所以这一次一定要赢。
默默的观察着局势，苏环操控着自己的英雄，放逐之刃瑞雯。在S3赛季瑞雯是一位极其强势的上单英雄，以暴力血腥著称。
由于在S4赛季中却被砍了一大刀，渐渐淡出了人们视线外，退居二线。
而在S4赛季渐渐的进入上单肉的时代时，苏环却还是热爱着瑞雯这一暴力英雄，他觉得瑞雯的光速QA简直是帅到了极致。
就算是无双剑姬的一秒五刀在他心中都比不上瑞雯的光速QA。
虽然无双剑姬亦是他喜欢的上单英雄之一，但是瑞雯才是他的本命英雄。
断剑重铸之日，骑士归来之时。

刚踏入英雄联盟这坑的时候，瑞雯作为那一周的免费英雄，这一句充满悲凉坚定的台词就深深地击中了苏环心中的个人英雄主义的情节。
之后苏环就看了大量的瑞雯视频，越看越爱，越看越喜欢。
其中一些什么瑞雯1V3，瑞雯1V4的视频简直让苏环心中充满狂热。
当然并不是真正意义上的1V3或1V4，而是对方一个打完被杀了后，另一个又赶到战场又被杀。
当然虽然是这样的形式，三杀，四杀。但是在苏环心中却依旧留下不可磨灭的印象。
这是一个能以一己之力挽救全局的英雄，这是苏环在看了大量视频时，脑内闪过的狂热想法。
召唤师峡谷中，战场之上瞬息万变。
这时苏环发现对方的女警一个走位失误，当然其实也不算是走位失误，毕竟苏环这一方有着石头人这个辅助，他的大招势不可挡是极有威慑力的。
紫色方的两位C位都不敢太过于走得太靠近，生怕石头人一个大招把他们击飞然后被秒。
要知道现在已经打到了后期了，已经三十多分钟了。
基本上被控住就是被秒的节奏，而且是一波GG，所以双方打得都非常小心。
而苏环操控的瑞雯在紫色方三狼这边死角处，基本没眼就看不见他。而且刚刚打野皇子已经用扫描透镜查探了一番，已经把眼清掉了，所以现在是没有眼位的。
所以这个女警过来，应该是抱着侥幸心理想着插个眼或者放个夹子，侦探一下。
只不过这一次女警却是彻底的栽了。
“皇子注意，我要上了。”看着越来越靠近的女警，苏环冷静的说了一声，提示道。
“好！”皇子沉稳的应道。
随后，苏环操控着瑞雯，一个闪现过去。
甫一出现，对方女警也是神意识，迅速一个口径绳网就想退去，但是苏环怎么会让他如意。
刚一闪现便是一个震魂怒吼，虽然女警已经位移了一点位置，但苏环还是把女警给晕眩住了，顺便还骗了女警唯一一个逃生技能。
随后他便没有管女警了，在他心中女警已经死了，就算慎传送也没用，因为他相信队友，或者说他相信这一把己方的阵容。

上单瑞雯，中单豹女，下路石头人，伊泽瑞尔，打野皇子，这是蓝色方的阵容。
“瑞雯，Nice！！”当瑞雯晕眩住女警前，本以为要被女警位移技能逃了时，却没想到还是被瑞雯控住了，皇子激动的大叫了一声。
不由得皇子不激动，要是瑞雯没有控制住女警的话，那么这一波必定会被反打，而且非常有可能会被反团灭。
由于做好了准备的皇子，几乎同一时间的一个德邦军旗插下，紧接着一个巨龙撞击，硬生生的把女警给击飞了起来，以防万一他开启了有着小蓝盾之称的黄金圣盾技能。
“石头人大招给炸弹人，不求杀死，牵制住就好。”
同一时间紧随其后的是豹女一标标准投掷和伊泽瑞尔的大招精准弹幕。
期间紫色方娜美一个闪现，想要挡下豹女的标准投掷，但是反应却是慢了一拍。没有想到蓝色方会选择在没有兵线的情况下强行越塔强杀。
所以一个闪现没有挡下豹女的标准投掷，反而白白浪费了一个唯一逃生技能闪现。
只见豹女那一发标准投掷命中女警后，直接把近乎满血的打成了死血，这还是女警开了屏障的缘故。
随后伊泽瑞尔的一个大招精准弹幕，扫过娜美，虽然减少了伤害但是再次扫过女警的时候，却是直接收下了女警的人头。
说了这么，其实这紧紧只是发生在1秒内，至于慎的大招为何没有给女警，他表示不是他不想把大招给女警，而是他不敢。
因为瑞雯在那时只是一个小幅度位移往紫色上方走一下，避开了防御塔的伤害和仇恨，但是却游离在女警身旁，只要慎敢开启大招套盾，瑞雯就敢开启大招一套把女警带走。
随后紫色方就要面临3V5的状态了。
这是一个完美的团战开局，苏环已经可以看到最强王者在向他招手了。
随后苏环看到，自家后方两位C位，被对面的伊芙琳给牵制住了，但他也不怎么担心。
只不过当他看见对面的慎却是开启大招，一道血量充足护盾套给了伊芙琳，再加上伊芙琳大招痛苦之拥的效果，看着那有些不可理喻的血量，却是皱了皱眉。
而紫色方炸弹人也没闲着，被石头人击飞之后，在看着离着自己极近的瑞雯，则是绝望，由于在上一波团战中闪现已经交了，所以现在他是没有闪现的。
知道自己必死，炸弹人也不跑了，而是一个大招往蓝色方两位C位扔去，EZ和豹女一看吓了一跳，这要被炸到还得了？
一瞬间豹女瞬间变身豹子一个闪现，随后一个猛扑，逃离了炸弹人大招的范围。
而伊泽瑞尔则是微微向后退去，待到炸弹人大招快要到达的时候，一个奥术跃迁躲了过去。

“EZ，豹女坚持一下，皇子去保护一下C位，我和石头人先把炸弹人解决了。”看着前面被石头人击飞的炸弹人，苏环淡淡的说了一句，打算先一套把炸弹人解决了再说。
“好的！”
至于娜美，在刚刚为了帮助伊芙琳牵制豹女和伊泽瑞尔已经把大招怒涛之啸交出，而碧波之牢却是对着苏环放出，想微微牵制一下。却是被苏环一个勇往直前躲了过去，顺便更加的靠近炸弹人。
所以娜美这几秒时间内的作用已经是微乎其微了，解决了炸弹人顺便把娜美带走好了，苏环脑中想着。
就在苏环想靠着瑞雯的一套技能爆发带走炸弹人的时候，突然电脑屏幕一闪，一瞬间蓝了。
看着眼前的屏幕，苏环傻眼了。
是的，关键的团战中电脑蓝屏了。
“卧槽！！”苏环心中愤怒，一瞬间身体下意识的用脚狠狠的踢了一下主机，却不知道触发了什么，只觉得全身发麻，一下子就晕了过去。
“草，瑞雯你怎么了，怎么不动了。我日，怎么回事。”
“别吼了，他掉线了。”看着屏幕上，瑞雯退出游戏的提示，石头人表示压力山大。
content_en:
Chapter 1: Falling out of control at the critical moment
(Friends who like this book can check out the author’s new book [Pets
In Summoner's Rift, a team battle is about to break out. This is a battle between teams, with both sides evenly matched.
At this time, the purple side, as the defensive side, clears troops under the outer tower with only one remaining tower in the middle, while the blue side presses the troops under the tower and harasses Poke outside the tower (long-range consumption).
Although the blue side actively suppressed the troop line, because the purple side had Ziggs, a hero with a strong ability to clear troops, the basic troop line was cleared in less than two seconds.
By the way, from time to time, bouncing bombs and Hex blasting minefields are thrown to harass and contain, which is extremely disgusting.
In YY voice channel.
"Fuck, how are we going to fight like this? I originally wanted to kill by force, but now I don't even dare to attack without a line of soldiers."
"And Shen on the other side has almost demolished our outer tower on the top lane. He really took the four-point push to its extreme."
A deep voice came from the voice, full of depression and speechlessness, but it came from his teammate, the Prince of Demacia.
When his teammates heard his complaints, they also complained. Why didn't they think of banning Bomberman? Now they are really confused.
Listening to the complaints of his teammates, Su Huan felt calm in his heart. He stared calmly at the computer screen. This battle was his last chance to advance to the King. If he won, he would be promoted to the King. If he lost, he would be returned to Diamond One.
I don’t know how many years or months it will take before I can play in the promotion tournament again.
So we must win this time.
Silently observing the situation, Su Huan controlled his hero, the Exile Blade Riven. In the S3 season, Riven was an extremely powerful top lane hero, known for his violence and bloodshed.
Because he was severely cut in the S4 season, he gradually faded out of people's sight and took a back seat.
When the S4 season gradually entered the era of top laners, Su Huan still loved the violent hero Riwen. He felt that Riwen's light speed QA was extremely handsome.
Even the Wushuang Swordswoman's five swords per second were not as good as Riven's light speed QA in his mind.
Although Wushuang Swordswoman is also one of his favorite top lane heroes, Riven is his natal hero.
The day when the broken sword is reforged, when the knight returns.
When he first entered the pit of League of Legends, Riven was the free hero that week. This line full of sadness and determination deeply touched the plot of personal heroism in Su Huan's heart.
After that, Su Huan watched a lot of Ruiwen videos, and the more she watched, the more she fell in love with them, and the more she watched them, the more she liked them.
Some of the videos of Ruiwen 1V3 and Ruiwen 1V4 simply filled Su Huan's heart with enthusiasm.
Of course, it is not 1V3 or 1V4 in the true sense, but after one of the opponents is killed, the other one rushes to the battlefield and is killed again.
Of course, although it is in this form, three kills, four kills. But it still left an indelible impression in Su Huan's heart.
This is a hero who can single-handedly save the whole situation. This was the fanatical thought that flashed through Su Huan's mind while watching a lot of videos.
In Summoner's Rift, the battlefield is changing rapidly.
At this time, Su Huan discovered that the opponent's female police officer made a positioning error. Of course, it was not actually a positioning error. After all, Su Huan had the support of the Stone Man, and his unstoppable ultimate move was extremely intimidating.
The two C-positions on the purple side did not dare to get too close, for fear that the stone man would knock them away with a big move and then be killed.
You must know that we have reached the late stage of the game now, more than thirty minutes have passed.
Basically, if you are controlled, you will be beaten in seconds, and it is a wave of GG, so both sides play very carefully.
As for Ruiwen controlled by Su Huan, she was in a blind spot on the purple side of the three wolves and could hardly see him. Moreover, the jungle prince had just used a scanning lens to investigate, and had already seenIt was cleared, so now there is no eye position.
So when this policewoman came here, she probably wanted to take a chance and put a spy in or put a trap.
But this time the policewoman was completely fooled.
"Prince, pay attention, I'm about to get involved." Looking at the policewoman who was getting closer and closer, Su Huan said calmly and warned.
"Okay!" The prince responded calmly.
Then, Su Huan controlled Ruiwen and flashed over.
As soon as he appeared, the other policewoman was also conscious. She quickly used a rope net to retreat, but how could Su Huan let him get what he wanted.
As soon as he flashed, there was a soul-shaking roar. Although the policewoman had moved a little, Su Huan still stunned the policewoman and deceived her only escape skill.
Then he ignored the policewoman. In his mind, the policewoman was already dead. Even teleporting was useless because he believed in his teammates, or in other words, he believed in his own lineup.
Top laner Riven, mid laner Leopard Girl, bottom lane Stoneman, Ezreal, and jungle prince, this is the lineup of the blue side.
"Riven, Nice!!" When Raven stunned the policewoman, he thought he was going to escape due to the policewoman's displacement skills, but unexpectedly she was still controlled by Raven. The prince shouted excitedly.
The prince couldn't help but feel excited. If Ruiwen hadn't controlled the policewoman, there would have been a counterattack, and it was very likely that the group would be wiped out.
Because the prince was well prepared, a German military flag was planted at almost the same time, followed by a giant dragon impact, which knocked the policewoman into the air, just in case he activated the golden holy shield skill known as the small blue shield.
"The Stone Man's ultimate move is for the Bomb Man. You don't want to kill him, just contain him."
At the same time, it was followed by Leopard Girl's standard throw and Ezreal's ultimate barrage.
During this period, purple Fang Nami flashed out, trying to block Leopard Girl's standard throw, but her reaction was a beat too slow. I didn't expect that the blue side would choose to forcefully cross the tower and kill without a line of troops.
Therefore, a flash did not block Leopard Girl's standard throw, but instead wasted a flash, the only escape skill.
After Leopard Girl's standard throw hit the policewoman, she was almost completely beaten to death. This was because the policewoman opened the barrier.
Then Ezreal's ultimate move accurately barraged Nami. Although the damage was reduced, when he swiped at the policewoman again, he directly took the head of the policewoman.
Having said that, in fact, this only happened within 1 second. As for why Shen's ultimate move was not given to the policewoman, he said it was not that he did not want to give the ultimate move to the policewoman, but that he did not dare.
Because at that time, Riven only made a small movement to the top of the purple, avoiding the damage and hatred of the defense tower, but she was still floating beside the policewoman. As long as Shen dared to activate the ultimate move and shield, Riven dared to activate the ultimate move and take the policewoman away.
Then the purple side will face a 3V5 situation.
This was a perfect start to the team fight, and Su Huan could already see the strongest king waving to him.
Then Su Huan saw that the two C positions behind him were restrained by Evelin on the opposite side, but he was not too worried.
But when he saw Shen on the opposite side activate his ultimate move, and a shield with sufficient health was given to Evelin, coupled with the effect of Evelin's ultimate move Embrace of Pain, he frowned when he saw the somewhat unreasonable amount of health.
The purple square bomber was not idle either. After being knocked away by the stone man, he looked at Riwen who was very close to him and felt despair. Since he had already flashed in the last wave of team battles, he did not flash now.
Knowing that he was bound to die, Bomber didn't run away. Instead, he threw a big move at the two C positions on the blue side. EZ and Leopard Girl were shocked when they saw it. How could they be blown up?
In an instant, the leopard girl transformed into a leopard and flashed, and thenHe pounced and escaped from the range of Bomberman's ultimate move.
Ezreal, on the other hand, stepped back slightly. When Bomberman's ultimate move was about to arrive, he used an arcane leap to dodge it.
"EZ, Leopard Girl, hold on. The prince will protect the C position. The Stone Man and I will take care of the Bomb Man first." Looking at the Bomb Man in front of him who was knocked away by the Stone Man, Su Huan said lightly, planning to take out the Bomb Man first.
"Okay!"
As for Nami, in order to help Evelin contain Leopard Girl and Ezreal, she had already handed over her ultimate move Roar of the Raging Waves, but Prisoner of Blue Waves was released at Su Huan, trying to contain her slightly. However, Su Huan bravely dodged it and got closer to the bomber.
So Nami's role in these few seconds is already minimal. Just take out the bomber and take Nami away at the same time, Su Huan thought in his mind.
Just when Su Huan wanted to use Riwen's set of skills to take away Bomberman, suddenly the computer screen flashed and turned blue for a moment.
Looking at the screen in front of him, Su Huan was dumbfounded.
Yes, the computer blue screened during the critical team battle.
"F*ck!!" Su Huan was angry in his heart. For a moment, he subconsciously kicked the host with his foot, but he didn't know what was triggered. He just felt numb all over his body and fainted all of a sudden.
"Hey, Ruiwen, what's wrong with you? Why can't you move? What's going on?"
"Stop yelling, he's offline." Looking at the prompt on the screen for Riven to exit the game, the stone man expressed that he was under great pressure.
